price_unit: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, from pricing.prompt and pricing.completion
temperature_policy: Production temperature is 0.2. The harness sends 0.2 when the catalog lists temperature. It omits temperature when the catalog does not list it, because those models reject the field. It does not send 0 unless a model accepts temperature and rejects every value except 0.

substitutions.requested: xAI grok-4.20 non-reasoning, production id grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning
substitutions.reason: OpenRouter has no grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning slug. x-ai/grok-4.20 is the 4.20 model. Reasoning is not mandatory and is off by default. The harness sends reasoning.enabled false.

This is the largest non-thinking model whose catalog name is Qwen3 Instruct (Qwen3 235B A22B Instruct 2507). Newer Qwen3.5–3.8 chat models exist, including qwen/qwen3.8-max-prime at $4 / $12 per million, but they are later generations and are not named Qwen3 Instruct. They were not substituted into this slot.

Mistral Medium 3.5 is the newest medium model on the catalog and the strongest model in the small-to-medium band. Mistral Small 4 (mistralai/mistral-small-2603, $0.15 / $0.60) is newer among small models and was not given a second slot.

substitutions.requested: cheapest strong ceiling, Gemini Pro-class or Claude Sonnet-class
substitutions.reason: Cheapest Pro-class or Sonnet-class model on the catalog: Gemini 2.5 Pro at $1.25 / $10 per million. Reasoning is mandatory on this slug, so the harness pins effort to minimal instead of disabling it. Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Sonnet 5.5 are both $2 / $10 and are held out as the two judges so neither judge scores its own translations.
